Adding one would introduce a new convention into a file whose brief is the smallest change; the captain can add it deliberately with `concurrency: { group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true }` at the top level if the cancellation semantics are wanted.

paths width: the filter is exactly the task's stated minimum. `bun.lock` is NOT in it and is arguably the one candidate to widen to — the github runner performs no host install (checkout + setup-node only), but the container's own install runs from the checkout in --mode source, so a lock-only change could alter the install without firing this lane. Not added: the captain decides.

`docker-e2e` is absent from the default branch's /actions/workflows list (docs-parity and gates only), which is the measured consequence of this file existing only on a feature branch; a pull_request run does not depend on that listing, but the dispatch button and the nightly schedule will keep doing nothing until a release carries the file to master.
